label: Binocular Stereo Prep Microscope
description: A long-reach boom-stand microscope providing 3D depth perception for high-precision manual preparation of micro-fossils.

components.function: Allows the microscope head to swing over large fossils or bulky lab equipment.
High-intensity, cool-temperature lighting to illuminate tiny details without melting adhesives.
Syncs the two eyepieces to the player's specific vision/focus.

game_mechanics.view_toggle: Player can switch between 'Workbench View' and 'Microscope View' to perform different tiers of cleaning.
game_mechanics.focal_plane_drift: As the player removes rock, the surface moves out of focus, requiring frequent adjustment of the 'Focus' dial.
